caseNameFull: J. L. Hudson v. O. L. Hopkins, as County Treasurer, etc. and William E. McGuire, as Administrator, etc. v. E. J. McCurdy, as County Treasurer, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oklahoma.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. Mr. Elmar *682E. Grinstead for plaintiffs in error. Mr. S. P. Freéling for defendants in error.
